verifications.claim: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket from Space Launch Complex 4E (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg Space Force Base, California.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California'; R2: 'from Vandenberg Space Force Base'
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly matches location and SLC-4E with successful launch; R2 confirms Vandenberg launch.

verifications.claim: The Falcon 9 rocket carried 25 Starlink satellites for the Starlink 17-35 mission.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: '25 Starlink satellites'; R2: 'Falcon 9 launched 25 Starlink satellites'
verifications.reasoning: Both sources confirm 25 Starlink satellites on Falcon 9, but neither specifies 'Starlink 17-35 mission' name.

verifications.claim: The launch occurred on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 7:49 p.m. PT (10:49 p.m. ET).
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Monday, April 6, 2026... 7:49 p.m. PT'; R2: '10:19 p.m. Monday'
verifications.reasoning: R1 matches date, day, and time exactly; R2 specifies different time (10:19 p.m.) on a Monday with no date, indicating contradictory details.

verifications.claim: The mission took a southerly trajectory.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: Neither source mentions trajectory or direction.

verifications.claim: The launch was visible across Southern California.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'visible over Southern California'; R2: 'seen across Southern California... Social media posts from areas such as Santa Monica and Huntington Beach'
verifications.reasoning: Both sources directly confirm visibility across Southern California.

verifications.claim: The first-stage booster landed on the drone ship "Of Course I Still Love You" in the Pacific Ocean.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the first stage will land on the "Of Course I Still Love You" drone ship... in the Pacific Ocean'; R2: 'expected to land on a ship in the Pacific Ocean'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe planned landing (future tense) on named drone ship in Pacific, but do not confirm it actually 'landed' post-launch.

verifications.claim: This was the 10th flight for the first-stage booster.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: '10th flight for the first stage booster'; R2: 'booster... has already flown 13 missions'
verifications.reasoning: R1 supports 10th flight; R2 contradicts with 13 missions.
